rationale: Production change is a minimal, correct 3-line branch in extended_error() following the established per-error-code pattern. All five acceptance criteria pass. business_review.criterion: Chat displays AGENT_MSG_TOKEN_LIMIT when model output limit is reached
business_review.notes: 3-line branch in extended_error() short-circuits before str(exception) and returns err.message, which the classifier resolves to config.AGENT_MSG_TOKEN_LIMIT. TestExtendedError verifies exact equality.

business_review.criterion: Chat does not display TOKEN LIMIT EXCEEDED, finish_reason, model name, tool names, or config instruction
business_review.notes: New branch prevents all raw internals reaching the caller. TestExtendedError asserts absence of TOKEN LIMIT EXCEEDED, finish_reason, model name, and max_output_tokens. Inverted test_exception_includes_tool_names asserts tool names absent from extended_error output.

business_review.criterion: Real user-quota exhaustion continues to report correctly (separate path, untouched)
business_review.notes: LiteLLMErrorClassifier / LITE_LLM_CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED_ERROR path is untouched, per spec out-of-scope declaration.

business_review.criterion: HIDE_AGENT_STREAMING_EXCEPTIONS=True path continues to work correctly (untouched)
business_review.notes: Hidden-streaming path is untouched, per spec out-of-scope declaration.

business_review.criterion: All existing tests pass with updated assertions; one new test covers extended_error branch for AGENT_TOKEN_LIMIT
business_review.notes: 43 tests pass. All 8 raw-internals assertions listed in the spec removal table are removed and replaced with structured-attribute assertions. TestExtendedError class added with complete coverage of the new branch.

standards_review.notes: Both commits use EPMCDME-13459: prefix with colon separator, matching the documented format.
